We leverage cutting-edge AI to proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks *before* they disrupt operations, impacting revenue, and damaging brand reputation.  Traditional risk assessment is reactive and relies on outdated data.  Aegis Insights delivers continuous, real-time visibility into your entire supply chain, providing actionable intelligence to strengthen your defenses. We're initially targeting Fortune 500 companies in the financial services, healthcare, and manufacturing sectors – organizations facing the highest levels of regulatory scrutiny and potential financial loss. We've already secured letters of intent from two pilot customers and are demonstrating impressive accuracy in identifying hidden vulnerabilities. We're currently raising a $3M seed round to accelerate product development and expand our sales and marketing efforts. I’m actively seeking connections with experienced cybersecurity investors, supply chain experts, and potential strategic partners.  Let's connect if you’re passionate about building resilient supply chains and are looking to invest in the future of risk management.
